using JSON3, Base64, CUDA
# Timing and parity of the CUDA adjoint and HVP of solver-shaped kernels, glue kernels on and off, same inputs.
# SPEC: per kernel, the primal arguments in order (name, kind, init). kind A = array, O = length-1 array, I = Int, F = Float64.
const SPEC = Dict(
    "sv_jacobi2d" => (layout = :vec, args = [(:f, :A, :in), (:u, :A, :z), (:un, :A, :z), (:rr, :O, :z), (:nx, :I, :m), (:ny, :I, :m), (:maxit, :I, :it), (:tol2, :F, 1.0e-300), (:h2, :F, 0.01)]),
    "sv_cg2d" => (layout = :vec, args = [(:b, :A, :in), (:x, :A, :z), (:r, :A, :z), (:p, :A, :z), (:Ap, :A, :z), (:rs, :O, :z), (:s, :O, :z), (:t, :O, :z), (:nx, :I, :m), (:ny, :I, :m), (:maxit, :I, :it), (:tol2, :F, 1.0e-300)]),
    "sv_pcg2d" => (layout = :vec, args = [(:b, :A, :in), (:dg, :A, :c4), (:x, :A, :z), (:r, :A, :z), (:z, :A, :z), (:p, :A, :z), (:Ap, :A, :z), (:rz, :O, :z), (:s, :O, :z), (:t, :O, :z), (:nx, :I, :m), (:ny, :I, :m), (:maxit, :I, :it), (:tol2, :F, 1.0e-300)]),
    "phc_cg_laplace2d" => (layout = :mat, args = [(:x, :A, :z), (:b, :A, :in), (:r, :A, :z), (:p, :A, :z), (:ap, :A, :z), (:tol, :F, 1.0e-300), (:nint, :I, :nint), (:maxit, :I, :it)]),
    "phc_jacobi2d" => (layout = :mat, args = [(:u, :A, :z), (:v, :A, :z), (:f, :A, :in), (:h2, :F, 0.01), (:tol, :F, 1.0e-300), (:nint, :I, :nint), (:maxit, :I, :it)]))

# host arrays (Float64) and Int/Float arguments of one call; `dev` moves an array to the device
function build_args(name, mode, m, it, dev)
    spec = SPEC[name]; N = m * m
    ivals = Dict(:m => m, :nint => m - 2, :it => it)
    shape = spec.layout == :mat ? (m, m) : (N,)
    mk(f) = reshape([f(c) for c in 1:N], shape)
    interior(c) = (i = mod(c - 1, m) + 1; j = div(c - 1, m) + 1; (2 <= i <= m - 1 && 2 <= j <= m - 1) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    patt(c) = (1.0 + 0.5 * sin(1.7 * c + 0.3 * c * c) + 0.3 * cos(2.9 * c)) * interior(c)
    args = Any[]; arrs = Pair{String,Any}[]; tang = Any[]; named = Dict{Symbol,Any}()
    for (nm, kind, init) in spec.args
        if kind == :A
            host = init == :in ? mk(patt) : init == :c4 ? fill(4.0, shape) : zeros(shape)
            adjh = mk(c -> cos(0.37 * c) * interior(c))
            a = dev(host); ab = dev(adjh)
            push!(args, a, ab); push!(arrs, string(nm) => a, string(nm, "_adj") => ab)
            mode == :hvp && (td = dev(mk(c -> 0.1 * sin(0.23 * c) * interior(c))); tbd = dev(mk(c -> 0.1 * cos(0.41 * c) * interior(c))); push!(tang, td, tbd); push!(arrs, string(nm, "_tan") => td, string(nm, "_tanadj") => tbd))
        elseif kind == :O
            a = dev(zeros(1)); ab = dev(zeros(1))
            push!(args, a, ab); push!(arrs, string(nm) => a, string(nm, "_adj") => ab)
            mode == :hvp && (td = dev(zeros(1)); tbd = dev(zeros(1)); push!(tang, td, tbd); push!(arrs, string(nm, "_tan") => td, string(nm, "_tanadj") => tbd))
        elseif kind == :I
            push!(args, ivals[init]); named[nm] = ivals[init]
        else
            push!(args, Float64(init), 0.0)
            mode == :hvp && push!(tang, 0.0, 0.0)
        end
    end
    return (vcat(args, tang), arrs, named)
end

# number of arguments the generated function takes (without the stacks)
function stack_inputs(M, name, ivals)
    init = getfield(M, Symbol("initstacks_", name, "_b_cuda"))
    nms = Base.method_argnames(first(methods(init)))[2:end]
    return init(map(n -> ivals[n], nms)...)
end

function run_case(M, name, mode, m, it, dev, sync)
    (args, arrs, ivals) = build_args(name, mode, m, it, dev)
    stacks = stack_inputs(M, name, ivals)
    f = getfield(M, Symbol(name, mode == :hvp ? "_hv_cuda" : "_b_cuda"))
    sync(); t0 = time_ns()
    f(args..., stacks...); sync()
    t = (time_ns() - t0) / 1e6
    return t, arrs
end

const FILES = Dict{String,String}("sv_jacobi2d|b|on" => "", "sv_jacobi2d|b|off" => "", "sv_jacobi2d|hv|on" => "", "sv_jacobi2d|hv|off" => "", "sv_cg2d|b|on" => "", "sv_cg2d|b|off" => "", "sv_cg2d|hv|on" => "", "sv_cg2d|hv|off" => "", "sv_pcg2d|b|on" => "", "sv_pcg2d|b|off" => "", "sv_pcg2d|hv|on" => "", "sv_pcg2d|hv|off" => "", "phc_cg_laplace2d|b|on" => "", "phc_cg_laplace2d|b|off" => "", "phc_cg_laplace2d|hv|on" => "", "phc_cg_laplace2d|hv|off" => "", "phc_jacobi2d|b|on" => "", "phc_jacobi2d|b|off" => "", "phc_jacobi2d|hv|on" => "", "phc_jacobi2d|hv|off" => "")
const NAMES = ["sv_jacobi2d", "sv_cg2d", "sv_pcg2d", "phc_cg_laplace2d", "phc_jacobi2d"]
mods = Dict{String,Module}()
for (k, b64) in FILES
    m = Module(Symbol("M", abs(hash(k))))
    Base.include_string(m, String(base64decode(b64)))
    mods[k] = m
end
dev(x) = CuArray(x)
sync() = CUDA.synchronize()
rel(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b)) / max(maximum(abs.(a)), 1e-300)
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())), "rows" => Any[])
sizes = ((18, 50), (66, 50), (258, 50), (514, 30), (1026, 10))
for name in NAMES, mode in (:adjoint, :hvp), (m, it) in sizes
    row = Dict{String,Any}("kernel" => name, "mode" => String(mode), "m" => m, "maxit" => it)
    try
        kind = mode == :hvp ? "hv" : "b"
        Moff = mods["$name|$kind|off"]; Mon = mods["$name|$kind|on"]
        for w in 1:2; run_case(Moff, name, mode, m, it, dev, sync); run_case(Mon, name, mode, m, it, dev, sync); end
        best = Dict("off" => Inf, "on" => Inf); outs = Dict{String,Any}()
        for rep in 1:5
            for (tag, M) in (("off", Moff), ("on", Mon))
                (t, arrs) = run_case(M, name, mode, m, it, dev, sync)
                best[tag] = min(best[tag], t)
                rep == 1 && (outs[tag] = Dict(k => Array(v) for (k, v) in arrs if endswith(k, "_adj") || endswith(k, "_tanadj")))
            end
        end
        row["off_us_per_it"] = best["off"] * 1e3 / it; row["on_us_per_it"] = best["on"] * 1e3 / it
        row["speedup"] = best["off"] / best["on"]
        keys_ = sort(collect(keys(outs["off"])))
        row["rel_diff"] = maximum(rel(outs["off"][k], outs["on"][k]) for k in keys_)
        row["maxabs"] = maximum(maximum(abs.(outs["on"][k])) for k in keys_)
        row["finite"] = all(all(isfinite, outs["on"][k]) for k in keys_)
        row["changed"] = sum(count(!=(0.0), outs["on"][k]) for k in keys_)
    catch e
        row["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 500)
    end
    push!(res["rows"], row)
    GC.gc(); CUDA.reclaim()
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
